integrity: Symbolic proof over arbitrary finite fields with explicit block parameterization and Gaussian counts; five exhaustive small-field parameter checks independently evaluate the block identities and ranks. Scientific review is self-review only, not independent certification.
limitations: Fixed maximal-rank square-zero first matrix in even dimension; not arbitrary nilpotent pairs.
Counts individual compatible matrices, not joint similarity orbits.
Asymptotic statements fix half-dimension before increasing field size.
Equivalent enumerations might exist under other representation-theoretic formulations.
title: Joint ranks of commuting square-zero matrices over finite fields
